errors.text: The proposed material is a homogenized refractory BCC W-Ta-Ni-Fe alloy, whereas the target is an as-cast AlCoCrFeNi2.1 eutectic HEA containing FCC and B2 phases.
The hypothesis replaces the target L12 ordering and jagged FCC/B2 phase-boundary mechanism with D0a/D022 precipitation, coarsening, and Orowan bypass.

The cited evidence establishes that coherent D0a and D022 precipitates can exist after a particular treatment, but it does not demonstrate their sequential formation and dissolution, a ductility minimum, or ductility recovery by coarsening.
The experiment does not examine crack initiation and dislocation pile-ups at jagged phase-boundary tips or exclude impurity-segregation-mediated intergranular embrittlement.
